io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.name: corvint-mcp

tools.name: corvint.docs_claims
tools.description: List the claims about a path or paths, the claims a text query ranks, or supplied status claims by state, qualifier and run. Returns claims, each with its claim_kind and anchors, filterable by kind and exclude_kind. For subjects rather than claims, use corvint.docs_search. Read-only, source-revalidated experimental corpus evidence; generated authority and explicit limitations remain. Which tests to run is not a docs question: ask corvint.affected on the testing server `corvint mcp`.

caller_revision.description: Optional full lowercase Git object ID of the caller's checkout, so freshness is judged against it.

exclude_kind.description: One claim kind, or a list of kinds, to leave out.

kind.description: One claim kind, or a list of kinds, to keep.

offset.description: Results to skip before the first returned one, for paging.

path.description: One repository-relative path; give path or paths, not both.

paths.description: A batch of distinct repository-relative paths answered with one verification; give path or paths, not both.

qualifier.description: Optional supplied status qualifier; requires state.

query.description: Free-text query ranking claims by their text; give one of path, paths, query or state.

retirement.description: Optional retirement policy: evaluated_at plus age or merge-distance bounds after which evidence counts as retired.

evaluated_at.description: RFC 3339 time the policy is evaluated at.

max_age_seconds.description: Evidence older than this many seconds counts as retired.

max_merge_distance.description: Evidence more than this many merges behind counts as retired.

merge_distance.description: The caller's merge distance from the evidence revision.

source_revision.description: Revision the evidence was produced at.

state.description: Supplied status state to filter claims by, instead of a path or query.

tools.name: corvint.docs_draft
tools.description: Draft source-pinned Markdown orientation from an owner Markdown source and a tracked module directory in any language the native index extracts declarations from (others are refused by name), identical to `corvint docs draft` (docs/specs/source-documentation-draft-v0.md, experimental). dry_run true previews over an untracked working-tree owner file or inline owner_markdown; that result is NOT_ADMISSIBLE, governs nothing, and docs_consume refuses it (SDD-V0-019). Which tests to run is not a docs question: ask corvint.affected on the testing server `corvint mcp`.

source.description: Owner Markdown source, repository-relative; tracked unless dry_run.

tools.name: corvint.docs_search
tools.description: Find documentation subjects by a free-text query. Returns ranked subject hits with anchors. For claims only, use corvint.docs_claims. Read-only, source-revalidated experimental corpus evidence; generated authority and explicit limitations remain. include ["claims"] adds claim hits to the subject hits, ranked together and labelled in result_kinds; for claims only, use the claims operation (corvint.docs_claims). The receipt is compact by default: each anchor once in anchors, named elsewhere by id, each limitation once in limitations, named elsewhere by index, and no capabilities unless include names "capabilities"; receipt "full" returns the full receipt. Which tests to run is not a docs question: ask corvint.affected on the testing server `corvint mcp`.

caller_revision.description: Optional full lowercase Git object ID of the caller's checkout, so freshness is judged against it.

include.description: "claims" adds claim hits ranked with the subject hits; "capabilities" adds the corpus capabilities to a compact receipt.

kind.description: One subject kind, or a list of kinds, to keep.

offset.description: Results to skip before the first returned one, for paging.

tools.name: corvint.help
tools.description: Return the task-indexed agent guide exactly as `corvint help guide` prints it (the default), one command's catalog entry exactly as `corvint help --json COMMAND` prints it (command NAME, under 5 KB), or with topic catalog the full command catalog (corvint-capability-catalog/0, about 180 KB) exactly as `corvint help --json` prints it. Reads only the binary, never the repository.

tools.name: corvint.impact
tools.description: Compile revision-bound impact evidence without source bodies. Capabilities: Go (.go): path, package imports; Ruby (.rb): path, markers, advisory autoload constant references, reverse imports unknown; JavaScript (.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs) and TypeScript (.ts/.tsx): path, literal relative/profile/tsconfig-alias imports, unresolved bare imports unknown. Non-Go paths name experimental non-go-syntax-v0. Dynamic dispatch and test closure remain unknown. The receipt equals CLI corvint impact with the syntax profile for the same paths, revision and limit; the CLI admits more suffixes and --base (corvint impact --capabilities). MCP accepts paths only.

tools.name: corvint.status
tools.description: Observe Git commit, tree, worktree state, and a privacy-preserving dirty-path digest. Gitlinks bind commit IDs; nested submodule contents are outside coverage.

tools.name: corvint.test_validity
tools.description: Project the test-level results of one corvint-js-test-provider document at a repository-relative path, or with discover:true the newest retained provider document under .corvint/test-evidence, through the shared five-axis test-validity shape, identical to `corvint test-validity --receipt FILE` or `--discover`; with neither every axis is UNSUPPORTED (docs/specs/mcp-test-validity-profile-v0.md, experimental).
